## About
Charles Pest Control Services, Inc. is a family owned company based in Cedar Hill. Marvin Charles, Sr. leads the company as President, with Gunniga Charles as Vice President and Marvin Charles, Jr. supervising in the field. Kourtnie Charles runs the office and Elizabeth Charles handles sales and outreach.
We want a good relationship with you and a bad relationship with pests. We treat our customers like family, and honesty, integrity and professionalism are the standards our staff holds to.
We serve commercial and residential properties across Texas, and we've been featured on Angie's List. Customers rate us 4.6 on Google from 34 reviews.

## Services
- General Pest Control: Finding spiders, insects and other pests in your home? We'll take care of them.
- Termite Treatment: Termites can go unnoticed for a long time. We offer a range of termite treatments and plans fit to your property.
- Bed Bugs: Bed bugs keeping you up at night? Our professionals know exactly what to look for and will tell you how we plan to treat it.
- Rodent Control: A mouse you see usually means more you don't. We'll show you what you're dealing with and the best way to get them out of your home or business.
- Fleas: We help get rid of fleas on your pets, in your house and in your yard, and we'll share the cleaning steps that keep them from coming back.
- Lawn Services: If ants, millipedes or other pests are getting in the way of family time outside, our technicians have yard treatments to help.
- Integrated Pest Management (IPM): Our IPM program combines preventive and corrective measures to keep pests from turning into real problems.
- Commercial Services: Pests cost businesses money. We offer preventative service for commercial and industrial facilities.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free quotes?
A: Yes. Fill out the quote form or give us a call and we'll get you an estimate.

Q: Do you work on homes or businesses?
A: Both. We service commercial and residential properties across Texas.

Q: When is your office open?
A: Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Should I treat my yard for fleas too?
A: We suggest treating your home and yard together so you get every stage of the flea life cycle. Washing your pet's bedding and tossing the vacuum bag each time helps too.
